name: copilot-scope-docs
description: Documentation toolchain for CopilotScope: renders docs/diagrams/*.mmd to vector PDF for the LaTeX editions, and checks that the bilingual documents stay paired. The product itself is .NET — this package.json exists only for the documentation build, which is why it declares no dependencies beyond the two tools that build it.

scripts.lint:docs: npm run check:diagrams && npm run check:parity
